overview: The Community Development Board appointed an acting chair, endorsed submitting a zoning amendment for the Salem Street Corridor, and released a covenant for the Bridal Path subdivision. The board also opened a public hearing for a proposed 248-unit multifamily development at 10 and 20 Revere Beach Parkway, which was ultimately continued to October 15, 2025.

items.title: Election of Acting Chair
items.summary: The board voted to suspend the rules for electing permanent officers and appointed Adam Behrens as acting chair for the meeting.

items.title: Salem Street Neighborhood Corridor District Zoning Amendment
items.summary: The board approved submitting a zoning amendment to the City Council to change the Salem Street and Park Street node back to the Mixed Use 1 zoning district as originally recommended by the board.

items.title: Bridal Path Subdivision Covenant and Tripartite Agreement
items.summary: The board approved releasing the existing subdivision covenant and replacing it with a tripartite agreement, authorizing the planning director to sign the documents.

items.title: Site Plan Review: 10 and 20 Revere Beach Parkway
items.summary: The board held a public hearing on a site plan review for a proposed seven-story, 248-unit residential structure, and voted to continue the hearing to October 15, 2025, to address traffic and private way concerns.
